name: React 19 Patterns
description: Enforces React 19 best practices including the use() hook, Actions, and optimistic updates.
content:
# React 19 Patterns Rules

- Use the `use()` hook to read promises and context — replaces `useEffect` for data fetching and `useContext` for reading context
- Use Actions (`useActionState`) for form submissions — handles pending states, errors, and optimistic updates automatically
- Use `useOptimistic()` for instant UI feedback — update the UI before the server responds, revert on failure
- Use `useFormStatus()` inside form components to show loading states — no more manual `isSubmitting` state
- Use `<form action={serverAction}>` for progressive enhancement — forms work without JavaScript
- Prefer `ref` as a prop instead of `forwardRef` — React 19 supports ref as a regular prop on function components
- Use `<Suspense>` to wrap async components — show fallback UI while promises resolve
- Use the `use()` hook to conditionally read context — unlike `useContext`, it can be called inside conditionals and loops
- Preload resources with `preload()`, `preFetchDNS()`, `preconnect()` from `react-dom` for faster page loads
- Use document metadata components (`<title>`, `<meta>`, `<link>`) directly in components — React 19 hoists them to `<head>`
- Avoid `useEffect` for data fetching — use `use()` with Suspense or a data fetching library instead
- Use `useTransition()` to mark state updates as non-urgent — keeps the UI responsive during heavy renders
